integration_issues.flow: I Need Help · Available now chip
integration_issues.issue: Filter shows 9 rows but only 4 display the string 'Available now' in the meta line. Backend filters by user.active_now boolean (server.py:2310) while the card shows professional_profiles.availability free-text (e.g. 'Evenings and weekends'). Not a bug per se, but the label 'Available now' on the chip vs 'Evenings and weekends' on the card row is confusing for users. Suggest either (a) filter on availability='Available now' string to match label, or (b) hide/adjust the availability string when active_now is true, or (c) rename chip to 'Active now'. Reference: ProfessionalHome.tsx:175 chip label; server.py:2310 filter; server.py:2170 pub['active_now']=u.get('active_now', True).
